secureSessionCookie.description: Secure NextAuth session cookie used by HTTPS production deployments.

cronSecret.description: Scheduler-only CRON_SECRET. This is not a user API credential.

WorkspaceIdHeader.name: X-Workspace-Id
WorkspaceIdHeader.description: Selects the active workspace for this request. Membership and the documented minimum role are always revalidated. When omitted, the authenticated user's active workspace fallback is used.

x-runtime-refinements: When primaryCurrentAge is supplied, primaryAgeAsOfDate cannot be explicitly null.
When all are supplied, bearReturnBps must not exceed baseReturnBps and baseReturnBps must not exceed bullReturnBps.
Asset-class and geography keys must be unique within their respective arrays.
Each asset-class band must satisfy minimumBps <= targetBps <= maximumBps.
Weights for every represented dimension must total exactly 10000 basis points.
endsOn cannot precede startsOn when both are supplied.
An investment cannot be reallocated to itself.

Forbidden.description: The session lacks the required workspace role

NotFound.description: The workspace-scoped resource was not found

Conflict.description: The request conflicts with current state or idempotency history

UnprocessableEntity.description: The JSON body or query failed schema validation

RequestTooLarge.description: The request body exceeds the route-specific byte limit

UnsupportedMediaType.description: The request body must use application/json or a +json media type
